title: Android build 13 ready for installation on both phones
summary: Signed version 1.0.11 APK built and audited locally. Physical two-phone acceptance and installation remain pending.

changes.detail: Recovered the failed memory-heavy build using a bounded heap and a single worker; packaged the saved viewer and native sharing recovery changes.
Created a signed arm64 build 13 APK, verification metadata and archive audit results.

validation.name: Native build
validation.detail: Gradle testDebugUnitTest and assembleRelease succeeded in 15m26s; 6 native tests passed.

validation.name: Viewer, history, TypeScript and lint
validation.detail: 11 focused tests, TypeScript and focused ESLint passed.

validation.name: APK identity and contents
validation.detail: Version 1.0.11 / code 13, arm64-v8a, 152131500 bytes; valid signature matches prior release signer. Native server, stopWithTask=false, exact viewer source assets and automated verification report confirmed. SHA256 5d78db289941c3f4e336a970bf7febe244070b723161364c76161666cb140bb0.

validation.name: Artifact audit
validation.detail: 1369 decompressed ZIP entries passed checks for known private environment values, common credential patterns and private file paths. Does not establish absence of unknown or encoded secrets.

validation.name: Installation, two-phone acceptance and publication
validation.detail: No ADB phone connected. Install on both phones and verify approval, Home/app switching, return within two minutes, temporary network loss and explicit Stop. No public deployment or OTA update performed. APK bundles 149 reports through automated verification; this post-build audit is appended in workspace history for the next build.
